description: This Java source file defines the FineractProperties class and its nested configuration property classes, representing configuration settings for the Fineract core infrastructure, including tenant, mode, security, cache, and other system-wide properties.

classes.name: FineractProperties
classes.description: Main configuration properties class for Fineract, containing nested classes for various configuration sections.

classes.name: FineractTenantProperties
classes.description: Holds tenant-specific configuration details such as host, port, credentials, and parameters.

classes.name: FineractConfigProperties
classes.description: Overrides for tenant database configurations like pool sizes.

classes.name: FineractModeProperties
classes.description: Defines system mode flags such as read/write enabled, batch worker, and batch manager.

classes.name: FineractCorrelationProperties
classes.description: Correlation ID configuration for request tracking.

classes.name: FineractPartitionedJob
classes.description: Configuration for partitioned jobs with a list of partition properties.

classes.name: PartitionedJobProperty
classes.description: Details for individual partitioned job settings.

classes.name: FineractRemoteJobMessageHandlerProperties
classes.description: Configuration for remote job message handling via Spring, JMS, or Kafka.

classes.name: FineractRemoteJobMessageHandlerSpringEventsProperties
classes.description: Spring event-based remote job message handling.

classes.name: FineractRemoteJobMessageHandlerJmsProperties
classes.description: JMS-based remote job message handling configuration.

classes.name: FineractRemoteJobMessageHandlerKafkaProperties
classes.description: Kafka-based remote job message handling configuration.

classes.name: KafkaProperties
classes.description: General Kafka configuration with extra properties parsing.

classes.name: FineractEventsProperties
classes.description: Event system configuration including external event settings.

classes.name: FineractTaskExecutor
classes.description: Thread pool configuration for task execution.

classes.name: FineractExternalEventsProperties
classes.description: External event system configuration including producer settings.

classes.name: FineractExternalEventsProducerProperties
classes.description: Producer configuration for external events, JMS and Kafka.

classes.name: FineractExternalEventsProducerJmsProperties
classes.description: JMS producer configuration for external events.

classes.name: FineractExternalEventsProducerKafkaProperties
classes.description: Kafka producer configuration for external events.

classes.name: FineractExportProperties
classes.description: Export settings for reports, including S3 export.

classes.name: FineractJobProperties
classes.description: Job processing configuration including retry and COB settings.

classes.name: FineractApiProperties
classes.description: API-specific configuration, including body size limits.

classes.name: FineractBodyItemSizeLimitProperties
classes.description: Limits for inline loan COB items.

classes.name: FineractLoanProperties
classes.description: Loan module configuration, including transaction processing.

classes.name: FineractSecurityProperties
classes.description: Security settings including basic auth, 2FA, HSTS, OAuth2.

classes.name: FineractCacheDetails
classes.description: Cache entry TTL and size limits.

classes.name: RetryProperties
classes.description: Retry logic configuration for system operations.

classes.name: ExecuteCommandProperties
